hints.title: Pairing Requirement
hints.text: The array has length 2 * n. Dividing it into n pairs of equal elements requires each distinct number to appear an even number of times.

hints.title: Element Frequency Parity
hints.text: Count how many times each number appears in the array and verify that every frequency is divisible by 2.

hints.title: Direct Parity Tally
hints.text: You can tally frequencies in a lookup collection, or toggle inclusion in a set.

hints.title: Frequency Parity Check Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass to build frequency counts and another to check parity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairing elements by nested search takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency counter uses O(distinct numbers) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes necessity and sufficiency of even frequencies.
